'''Aven Rolk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Surviving the execution of [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|Contingency]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] after being stranded in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] frozen, Jedi Rolk tried and failed to reestablish the Jedi Order on [[Zissh]].

==Biography==
Aven Rolk was a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] and a member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. At some point during his service to the Order, Rolk was forced into an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] and placed into suspended animation in a stasis field. During his time in stasis, the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] consumed [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and when the conflict ended, both the Republic and the Order had been destroyed and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lords of the Sith]] reigned freely over civilized space.<ref name="RECG" />

Later, during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], Rolk was freed from his drifting prison and brought up to speed on galactic events. Determined to rebuild the Order, Rolk attempted to summon all surviving Jedi to the frozen world [[Zissh]] where he planned to construct a new Temple and overthrow the Empire. As news spread of his ambitious plan, even the up and coming hero of the rebellion, Force-sensitive [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] planned to answer the summons. However, before Rolk's movement could gain much momentum, the Empire heard of his plot and decided to eliminate him. Led by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], a group of [[Dark side adept/Legends|Dark Side Adepts]] hunted down Rolk and murdered him, leaving his body in an ice cave far in the world's frozen wastelands. While dead, Rolk's [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] lingered, wandering the desolate ice fields and waiting for the return of the Jedi.<ref name="RECG" />
